## Context / Problem
The Windows sweep on main (run 44911386034, job 136867764314, at a99339e8ce8) failed 2 tests and nothing else (20480 passed): `tests/unit/metrics/test_git_metrics.py::test_history_walk_cat_file_starts_do_not_grow_with_revisions` and `::test_oracle_cap_change_events_compares_unsampled_adjacent_revisions`, both `CalledProcessError: ['git', 'fast-import', '--quiet', '--export-marks=C:\\...\\repo.marks'] returned non-zero exit status 128`. Both use `_fast_import_history`, added by 863abe7cd19 (rubbery-adamantine-panda). This resets the 3-green-sweep count for charitable-tyrannical-hydra and sporting-feudalist-bluet.

## Root cause (verified)
`_fast_import_history` passes the fast-import stream with `text=True`. On Windows, Python's text-mode stdin translates every `\n` to `\r\n`. fast-import is line-oriented and byte-counted, so it reads `commit refs/heads/main\r` and exits 128 (the `data <n>` counts are also off by one per line). The marks path is not the cause.

Reproduction on macOS (Nov 21 2026): the same minimal stream fed with LF endings imports (rc 0); with each line ending converted to CRLF, `git fast-import` fails with `fatal: branch name doesn't conform to Git standards: refs/heads/main?` and writes a crash report.

## Approach
In `tests/unit/metrics/test_git_metrics.py`, `_fast_import_history` builds the stream as UTF-8 bytes and calls `subprocess.run` without `text=True` (`input=stream.encode("utf-8")`), with `data` counts taken from the encoded byte lengths as before. No newline translation then happens on any platform. No skip: fast-import is cross-platform.

## Scope
- `tests/unit/metrics/test_git_metrics.py`

## Testing
- A unit test feeds `_fast_import_history`'s exact stream through a CRLF translation check: it monkeypatches `subprocess.run` to capture `input` and asserts it is `bytes` containing no `\r`.
- The 2 failing tests pass on macOS and in a Windows sweep dispatched on a temp branch (`gh workflow run 294845723 --ref tmp/...`), run recorded here, branch deleted afterwards.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The 2 tests pass in a Windows sweep dispatched on the change, recorded here. (run 44918915960, sweep (windows) 136890433309: 20509 passed, 0 failed)
- [x] A test pins that the fast-import stream is sent as bytes with LF line endings. (test_fast_import_stream_is_sent_as_lf_bytes)
- [x] `make verify` passes and Gerrit gives Verified +1. (slot run 21687 + 226 passed; Gerrit 3514 LLM-Review +1, Verified +1; merged c363e576276)
